hero.headline: Survey Smarter, Build Stronger
hero.title: SITE ENGINEERING SURVEYS
hero.description:
Build Smarter from the Ground Up—our drone-enabled site engineering surveys deliver precise measurements, rapid terrain insights, and informed decision-making for your construction projects. By capturing high-resolution topographic data, 3D ground models, and accurate boundary visuals, we streamline site planning and reduce costly rework. Whether you're breaking ground or managing infrastructure upgrades, SmartGrid Surveying gives you the geospatial clarity needed to engineer with confidence and precision.

 <bold>Smartgrid Surveying is your trusted surveying partner!</bold>

WhatWeDo.headline: Precision Site Engineering Surveys
WhatWeDo.description: Build smarter from the ground up—SmartGrid Surveying's drone-powered site surveys deliver real-time terrain data, accurate site modeling, and faster decision-making for modern construction projects.

items.title: Topographic Mapping
items.description: We create detailed elevation models and contour maps using drone photogrammetry and LiDAR—crucial for earthworks and drainage planning.

items.title: Boundary & Layout Surveys
items.description: Ensure accurate positioning of foundations and infrastructure using georeferenced aerial data integrated with CAD and GIS systems.

items.title: Cut & Fill Calculations
items.description: Quickly compute volumes for excavation and grading work using drone-derived 3D models—enhancing cost-efficiency and project timelines.

items.title: Construction Progress Monitoring
items.description: Track development in real time through weekly or monthly flyovers, enabling teams to spot deviations from plans early and act fast.

items.title: Utilities Mapping
items.description: Identifying, mapping, and documenting existing and new utility networks to prevent conflicts and ensure safety.

items.title: Underground Utility Planning
items.description: Visualize terrain overlays and elevation profiles to plan trench paths and prevent utility conflicts before breaking ground.

items.title: Quality Assurance & As-Builts
items.description: Generate digital as-built maps to confirm compliance with designs—ensuring transparency, record-keeping, and safety audits.
